Singer.description: A choir member, or a musician who plays for the choir. A first name alone is not an identity.

Piece.description: A work in the choir's repertoire, known by its title.

Support.description: Who a singer relies on: their section leader, or the driver who gives them a lift to rehearsals.

Feature.description: Who a piece features in performance: its soloist or its accompanist.

Rehearsal.description: A rehearsal on the calendar. called_by arranged it, led_by runs it, pianist plays for it. A hope to rehearse is not an arranged rehearsal.

ScoreLoan.description: Choir copies of a score lent out. lent_by handed them over, borrower has them. returned stays empty until a return is recorded.

questions.q: Who sings the solo in Shenandoah?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Piece)-[:soloist]->(n1:Singer) WHERE n0.name = 'Shenandoah' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Piece)-[:accompanist]->(n1:Singer) WHERE n0.name = 'The Seal Lullaby' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: nnamdi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Singer)-[:leader]->(n1:Singer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: margit
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Singer)-[:charge]->(n1:Singer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: grainne
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Singer)-[:driver]->(n1:Singer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: esperanza
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Singer)-[:accompanied]->(n1:Piece) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Have the Carus copies been returned?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:ScoreLoan) WHERE n0.edition = 'Carus' RETURN n0.returned AS returned

questions.q: Is there a record of the Oxford copies being returned?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:ScoreLoan) WHERE n0.edition = 'Oxford' RETURN coalesce(n0.returned, false) AS returned

questions.q: Who borrowed copies of Ave Verum?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Piece)<-[:piece]-(n1:ScoreLoan)-[:borrower]->(n2:Singer) WHERE n0.name = 'Ave Verum' RETURN n2.name AS name

questions.q: Which rehearsals did Grainne Moloney call?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Singer)<-[:called_by]-(n1:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.name = 'Grainne Moloney' RETURN n1.focus AS focus

questions.q: How many singers came to the run-through?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.focus = 'run-through' RETURN n0.attendees AS attendees

questions.q: What focus and status do the Locus Iste rehearsals have?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Piece)<-[:piece]-(n1:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.name = 'Locus Iste' RETURN n1.focus AS focus, n1.status AS status

questions.q: What attendance did the class sessions have?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.focus CONTAINS 'class' RETURN n0.attendees AS attendees

questions.q: Was the hall booked for the warm-up session?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.focus = 'warm-up session' RETURN n0.venue_booked AS venue_booked

questions.q: Is there a record of a venue booking for the massed run?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.focus = 'massed run' RETURN coalesce(n0.venue_booked, false) AS venue_booked

questions.q: How many copies did Nnamdi Eze lend?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Singer)<-[:lent_by]-(n1:ScoreLoan) WHERE n0.name = 'Nnamdi Eze' RETURN n1.copies AS copies
